---
title: "Google account and databases"
subtitle: "Administrative spreadsheets in Google Drive and subscriber data handling"
---

The official RC42 Google account contains the forms and spreadsheets that provide dynamic data for the website. Routine content administration is conducted through four Google Sheets.

```
RC42 Google Drive
├── Forms
│   └── Submit a Community Contribution to ISA RC42 (Public Form)
├── Web Applications
│   └── Community Updates Subscription App
└── Core Spreadsheets
    ├── ISA RC42 Newsletter Database (Private subscribers)
    ├── ISA RC42 Community Submissions (Editorial inbox)
    ├── Active Members RC42 Social Psychology (Official directory)
    └── rc42_resources_workflow (Curated resources and publications)
```

## The four core spreadsheets

| Spreadsheet | Primary function | When to edit | Detailed documentation |
|:---|:---|:---|:---:|
| `ISA RC42 Newsletter Database` | Private list of subscribers who opted into Community Updates email alerts. | To review subscriber records or process an unsubscription request. | [Email and Community Updates](email.qmd) |
| `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` | Editorial inbox for news, calls for papers, events, and publications submitted through the website. | To review, edit, or approve community submissions. | [Community contributions](contributions.qmd) |
| `Active Members RC42 Social Psychology` | Official membership database used to build the Members Directory. | To add a new member, update renewal dates, or modify affiliation details. | [Members](members.qmd) |
| `rc42_resources_workflow` | Catalog of academic journals, handbooks, syllabi, datasets, and research tools. | To add an academic resource, update links, or adjust categories. | [Resources](resources.qmd) |
